list.title: Evaluation of all data
list.description: This page provides a detailed evaluation of all relevant data needed for managing watering groups and watering plans, as well as for maintaining trees and sensors. It shows how many watering plans have been recorded in the system, which vehicles carry out the most watering plans, and which districts are watered the most. You can also find out how many trees, watering groups and sensors have been created.
list.treeSectionTitle: Collected data on trees, watering groups & sensors:
list.clusterCountDescription: Watering groups group together trees with similar site conditions.
list.treeCountDescription: Incl. manually created or imported trees from other systems (e.g. database).
list.sensorCountDescription: This also counts sensors that are not linked to any vegetation.
list.wateringPlanCountDescription: This describes the number of all watering plans currently recorded in the system.
list.waterConsumptionDescription: Water consumption refers to all watering plans carried out during the specified period.
list.userCountLabel: Number of employees assigned to watering plans
list.userCountDescription: This describes the number of all employees linked to watering plans. Duplicates were not excluded.
